desc: Jester demon: three stacked layers of dark wings on each side with red crystal ribs, gold bell-tipped horns, tattered cape, red crystal scepter. Face: red slit eyes and a wide jagged grin. Chibi 16-bit pixel art character sprite, big head, small body, right-facing 3/4, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no halo, no shadow. Face is a solid black void with the described eyes. Palette lavender, white, violet, gold.
